title: Cost-Aware Abstention for LLM-Based IT Ticket Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.31657v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wrong automatic routing of an IT support ticket can cost more than human triage. We evaluate cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment: select a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs, then evaluate that frozen policy once on held-out test data. On a public 47,837-ticket, eight-class corpus, we compare four trained non-LLM classifiers with four large language models under zero- and few-shot prompting. Under the illustrative cost model (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5), TF-IDF with logistic regression and a threshold of 0.60 selected on calibration reduces test cost from 0.763 to 0.472, a 38.1% relative reduction (paired ratio-bootstrap 95% CI [35.7%, 40.4%]), while lowering wrong routes from 15.3% to 3.5%. translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型的IT工单分类的成本感知弃权方法
translated_abstract: IT支持工单的错误自动路由，其代价可能高于人工分诊。我们将成本感知弃权评估为一种离线的、成本条件下的就绪度评估方法：先在明确的成本设定下基于校准数据选择一个路由策略，随后仅在留出的测试数据上对该冻结策略进行一次评估。在一个包含47,837条工单、八个类别的公开语料库上，我们比较了四个经过训练的非大语言模型分类器与四个大语言模型在零样本和少样本提示下的表现。在示例性成本模型 (c_ok, c_triage, c_wrong) = (0, 1, 5) 下，基于校准数据选择的TF-IDF逻辑回归及0.60的阈值，将测试成本从0.763降至0.472，相对降低38.1%（配对比率自助法95%置信区间 [35.7%, 40.4%]），同时将错误路由率从15.3%降至3.5%。在事后成本参数分析中，冻结的校准选择策略还在16个设置中的14个里，在留出测试数据上同时优于“始终路由”和“始终弃权”两种基线。最强的p……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种离线的成本感知弃权评估框架，通过在校准数据上按显式成本选择并冻结路由策略，在真实IT工单数据上显著降低分类成本与错误路由率，并表明简单的TF-IDF逻辑回归结合成本感知阈值可优于大语言模型方案。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes cost-aware abstention as an offline, cost-conditional readiness assessment, showing that selecting and freezing a routing policy on calibration data under explicit costs—achieved even by a simple TF-IDF logistic regression classifier—substantially reduces IT ticket misrouting cost and error rates compared to LLM-based approaches.
